results.rationale: Consistency: glass table, vase, bouquet and background remain aligned; book page content/orientation is visibly reversed beyond a position change. Instruction: the book remains to the right of the vase, with its pages reversed; it has not moved to the opposite side. Quality: transparent table, reflections, floral texture and open-book shape are coherent and naturally integrated.

Consistency: pump silhouette, white glossy material, heel and sole remain visually consistent; poster background and typography are intended additions. Instruction: gold decoration, gradient and correct slogan appear, but the title is script instead of bold uppercase and an extra large Grace is duplicated below it. Quality: shoe and floral rendering are coherent, but the conspicuous duplicated title word disrupts the poster semantically.
